source_evidence: These benefits allow you to withdraw up to a certain amount each year for as long as you live regardless of market performance.
question: Misconception: A guaranteed lifetime withdrawal benefit means I can withdraw any amount I want for life, regardless of how my investments perform.
answer: A guaranteed lifetime withdrawal benefit generally guarantees withdrawals only up to a specified amount each year for as long as you live, even if the contract value falls to zero. It does not mean withdrawals are unlimited.
